entities.summary: Fiona Maeve Crawley is an American tennis player. She played college tennis for the North Carolina Tar Heels, where she was ranked as high as No. 1 nationally and won the NCAA team championship in 2023 and reached quarterfinals in singles. She won the ITA National Fall Championships with Elizabeth Scotty in 2021 and the NCAA doubles title with Carson Tanguilig in 2023.
